confirmedFindings.title: Flipped Sign Bit Mask in G.711 μ-law Compander
confirmedFindings.body: The sign calculation in G.711 μ-law encoding tests for positive values (pcm16 > 0) rather than negative values to set sign bit 0x80, inverting the sign mask and corrupting audio output with loud clipping noise.
